prompt.brief: Design a real-time sentiment platform that ingests social, review, and support streams, performs multilingual aspect-level analysis, and detects meaningful trend shifts with provenance.
successSignals: Define source connectors, deduplication, language detection, sentiment/emotion/aspect outputs, confidence, provenance, and deletion semantics.
Aggregate results by brand, topic, aspect, geography, and time window while handling bot noise, late events, changing taxonomies, and sampling bias.
Separate streaming ingestion and model inference from dashboard queries; support model versioning, replay, and at-least-once processing.
Explain shift alerts, privacy, human review, model fallback, failure recovery, observability, and a degraded mode.

functional: Ingest authorized posts, reviews, and feedback, normalize and deduplicate them, then classify sentiment, emotion, language, and aspects with confidence.
Expose near-real-time aggregates, representative evidence, trend charts, and alerts by tenant, brand, topic, aspect, locale, and time window.
Support source deletion requests, reprocessing with a new model, analyst feedback, alert acknowledgment, and replay after consumer failure.
nonFunctional: Meet p95 end-to-end processing under 2 seconds for sampled events and alert within five minutes of a sustained shift.
Scale to millions of messages per hour across many brands and languages without unbounded synchronous work.
Do not lose committed state; make retries and duplicate events safe.
Degrade safely when downstream workers, caches, or external dependencies fail.
scaleAssumptions: Millions of messages/hour across many languages
Partition by the primary tenant, user, item, or geographic key and isolate hot partitions.
Keep serving state bounded; retain raw events or durable records for replay and auditing.

metrics.label: Async boundary
metrics.description: Keep Fine-tune BERT/RoBERTa for sentiment classification, Use aspect extraction with sequence labeling models, Implement streaming ingestion with Kafka/Pub-Sub off the synchronous path.

dataFlow.title: Register and validate training data
dataFlow.description: The real time sentiment analysis platform gateway records an immutable dataset version, schema, lineage, quality status, and privacy disposition.

dataFlow.title: Build point-in-time features
dataFlow.description: Feature workers join real time sentiment analysis platform inputs using event-time watermarks, prevent leakage, and publish the same feature contract for training and serving.

dataFlow.title: Train and evaluate asynchronously
dataFlow.description: The orchestrator schedules real time sentiment analysis platform runs with checkpointed artifacts, reproducible environments, and metrics tied to the exact input versions.

dataFlow.title: Gate and serve a model version
dataFlow.description: A registry compares real time sentiment analysis platform quality, bias, safety, and compatibility gates before canary or production rollout with an immediate rollback pointer.

dataFlow.title: Monitor drift and learn from feedback
dataFlow.description: Online inference records latency, errors, drift, and delayed labels so real time sentiment analysis platform retraining is evidence-driven rather than triggered by guesswork.

architecture.title: Real Time Sentiment Analysis Platform ML platform architecture
architecture.summary: Design a real-time sentiment platform that ingests social, review, and support streams, performs multilingual aspect-level analysis, and detects meaningful trend shifts with provenance. The design separates reproducible data and feature lineage from queued training, approved model promotion, version-pinned serving, and feedback-driven monitoring.

layers.label: Reproducible data and feature plane
layers.description: Immutable inputs, feature snapshots, and lineage provide point-in-time-correct training and auditability.

layers.label: Training and model lifecycle

layers.label: Inference and feedback plane

layers.label: Model quality and platform operations
layers.description: Quality, drift, freshness, resource, and reliability signals are visible by tenant and version.

keyPaths.label: Reproducible training path
keyPaths.description: Dataset snapshot -> point-in-time features -> queued run -> evaluation gates -> model registry.

keyPaths.label: Approved inference path
keyPaths.description: Client -> gateway -> version-pinned serving -> prediction result, with feedback returned to the lifecycle plane.

connections.label: Dataset or inference request
connections.description: Real Time Sentiment Analysis Platform clients submit tenant-scoped data, experiment, prediction, and feedback requests through the authenticated boundary.

connections.label: Validated data/model command
connections.description: The gateway checks identity, schema references, quotas, and idempotency before registering an asynchronous ML operation.

connections.label: Immutable dataset snapshot
connections.description: Validated source data and artifacts are written with a content hash, source lineage, retention policy, and snapshot version.

connections.label: Dataset and feature metadata

connections.label: Point-in-time features

connections.label: Prediction and feedback record

connections.label: Training and data quality telemetry
connections.description: Operations observes queue lag, run duration, data quality failures, resource saturation, and reproducibility gaps.

connections.label: Inference and drift telemetry

deepDives.title: Reproducibility and leakage prevention
points: Pin real time sentiment analysis platform data, feature, code, dependency, and model versions for every run.
Use point-in-time joins and quarantine failed quality or privacy checks before training.
Keep raw inputs and artifacts immutable so a result can be replayed after a dependency changes.

deepDives.title: Safe promotion and serving contracts
points: Separate real time sentiment analysis platform model registration from deployment and require signed artifacts plus schema compatibility.
Use shadow traffic, canaries, rollback pointers, and per-version latency/error budgets.
Return model version and feature freshness so clients can explain or reproduce a prediction.

deepDives.title: Drift, feedback, and cost
points: Measure feature drift, prediction drift, label delay, and segment-level quality for real time sentiment analysis platform rather than only aggregate accuracy.
Sample expensive inference and cap retraining concurrency with an explicit GPU or compute budget.
Keep human corrections and delayed labels linked to the original prediction and model version.

tradeoffs.title: Batch versus online features
tradeoffs.recommendation: Prefer a shared feature contract with batch backfills and a low-latency online serving path for decisions that need freshness.
tradeoffs.caution: Two independently defined transformations create training-serving skew and hard-to-debug regressions.

tradeoffs.title: Synchronous versus asynchronous inference
tradeoffs.recommendation: Keep interactive real time sentiment analysis platform inference synchronous within a strict budget and queue large or expensive jobs.
tradeoffs.caution: A request path that waits for model loading, enrichment, or retraining turns downstream slowness into an outage.

tradeoffs.title: Global model versus segment models
tradeoffs.recommendation: Start with one versioned model and add segment-specific models only when quality or policy evidence justifies the operational cost.
tradeoffs.caution: Many simultaneously active versions multiply monitoring, rollback, and data-lineage burden.

commonMistakes: Training real time sentiment analysis platform on mutable data without recording a replayable dataset version.
Serving features from a different transformation or time window than the training job used.
Promoting a model on one offline metric without canary, safety, or segment-level checks.
Treating delayed labels and drift as a dashboard concern instead of a retraining input.
Allowing retries to create duplicate runs, artifacts, or promotions without idempotency keys.

followUps.question: How do you roll back a bad real time sentiment analysis platform model?
followUps.answer: Keep immutable artifacts and a last-known-good pointer; switch traffic atomically, stop promotion, and preserve affected prediction traces for analysis.

followUps.question: How do you detect training-serving skew?
followUps.answer: Compare feature definitions and sampled values by entity and event time, expose source watermarks, and alert on divergence before quality drops.

followUps.question: What happens when labels arrive weeks later?
followUps.answer: Store prediction records with model and feature versions, join delayed labels idempotently, and compute drift or quality by cohort.

The answer identifies the authoritative real time sentiment analysis platform state, versioning or deduplication boundary, and how derived views converge.
The answer partitions real time sentiment analysis platform traffic, isolates hot keys, and moves fan-out, retries, or rebuilds behind bounded asynchronous work.
The answer names freshness, backlog, error, cost, and recovery signals tied to the real time sentiment analysis platform user experience.
